mapper.select: SELECT sw.rw_id, sw.window_code, sw.start_time, sw.end_time, sw.confirmed, COUNT(fa.id) FILTER (WHERE fa.attack_faction_id = #{factionId}) AS self_attack_count, COUNT(fa.id) FILTER (WHERE fa.attack_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId}) AS opponent_attack_count FROM torn_faction_rw_stat_window sw LEFT JOIN torn_faction_attack fa ON fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.attack_start_time BETWEEN sw.start_time AND sw.end_time AND ((fa.attack_faction_id = #{factionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId}) OR (fa.attack_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{factionId})) WHERE sw.deleted = 0 AND sw.rw_id = #{rwId} GROUP BY sw.rw_id, sw.window_code, sw.start_time, sw.end_time, sw.confirmed ORDER BY sw.start_time
SELECT id, rw_id, window_code, start_time, end_time, confirmed, deleted, create_time, update_time FROM torn_faction_rw_stat_window WHERE deleted = 0 AND rw_id = #{rwId} ORDER BY start_time

SELECT sw.id, sw.rw_id, sw.window_code, sw.start_time, sw.end_time, sw.confirmed, sw.deleted, sw.create_time, sw.update_time FROM torn_faction_rw_stat_window sw WHERE sw.deleted = 0 AND sw.confirmed = true AND sw.rw_id = #{rwId} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_faction_attack fa WHERE fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.attack_start_time BETWEEN sw.start_time AND sw.end_time AND fa.attack_faction_id = #{factionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId} ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM torn_faction_attack fa WHERE fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.attack_start_time BETWEEN sw.start_time AND sw.end_time AND fa.attack_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{factionId} ) ORDER BY sw.end_time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT fa.attack_faction_id, fa.attack_user_id AS user_id, fa.attack_user_nickname AS nickname, COUNT(*) AS attack_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 60.0 / GREATEST(1, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (#{endTime} - #{startTime}))), 2) AS attack_rate_per_minute FROM torn_faction_attack fa WHERE fa.deleted = 0 AND fa.attack_start_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} AND ((fa.attack_faction_id = #{factionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId}) OR (fa.attack_faction_id = #{opponentFactionId} AND fa.defend_faction_id = #{factionId})) GROUP BY fa.attack_faction_id, fa.attack_user_id, fa.attack_user_nickname HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY attack_count DESC, user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO torn_faction_rw_stat_window (id, rw_id, window_code, start_time, end_time, confirmed, deleted, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{window.id}, #{window.rwId}, #{window.windowCode}, #{window.startTime}, #{window.endTime}, #{window.confirmed}, 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ON CONFLICT (rw_id, window_code) WHERE deleted = 0 DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE torn_faction_rw_stat_window SET start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, confirmed = #{confirmed}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 AND confirmed = false
